data.text: Instantly onboard retail investors with PAN, Aadhaar, address verification, and comprehensive AML-ready checks for rapid account activation.
Prevent duplicate accounts, identity misuse, and suspicious activity with real-time risk checks and advanced fraud detection across all transactions.
Enable compliant onboarding for investors, advisors, and partners with audit-ready flows and robust identity verification for seamless experience.
Apply enhanced KYC and fraud checks for high-risk trading activities, derivatives, or large transaction volumes, ensuring full compliance.
Automate payouts to brokers, advisors, and affiliates with full reconciliation, real-time tracking, and compliance-ready settlement records.
Ensure SEBI-compliant onboarding, reporting, and verification workflows with comprehensive audit trails required by regulatory bodies.
